title: Automation event WiFi SSID contains space
symptom: An automation that triggers a temp basal based on time and WiFi SSID does not trigger when the SSID contains a space.
cause: The thread does not establish a root cause; the maintainer states that spaces should work and added tests confirming it works with spaces. The original reporter later found another condition prevented the automation.
fix: No fix is stated; the maintainer indicates the delimiter is set to ';' and it should work, and tests show it works with spaces. The original reporter found another condition was the issue.
evidence_quote: delimiter is set to ';' it should work
